metadata.name: Qontinui Web Testing
metadata.description: Automation workflows for testing qontinui-web features. Used by Claude for autonomous development verification.
metadata.author: Joshua Spinak

workflows.name: Navigate to State Machine Builder
workflows.description:
Clicks Build > State Machine in the website navigation menu to open the State Machine Builder page.

Use when: Need to test or verify the State Machine Builder feature, or after making changes to state machine related code (state-machine-canvas, state nodes, transitions).
Verifies: Navigation menu works, Build dropdown opens, State Machine Builder page loads, canvas renders correctly, no console errors.
Prerequisites: qontinui-web frontend running on localhost:3001, user logged in to the application, a project is selected.
Success indicators: State Machine canvas is visible, toolbar appears, no errors in browser console, URL shows /build/state-machine.
Failure indicators: 404 error, blank page, canvas doesn't render, console errors about missing components, navigation menu doesn't respond to clicks.

workflows.name: Navigate to Web Extraction Page
workflows.description:
Clicks Discover > Web Extraction in the website navigation menu to view extraction results.

Use when: Need to verify extraction data displays correctly in the web UI, or after making changes to extraction-related frontend code.
Verifies: Discover dropdown opens, Web Extraction page loads, extraction list renders, images display correctly, state data is shown.
Prerequisites: qontinui-web frontend running on localhost:3001, user logged in, a project is selected. For meaningful verification, extraction data should exist in the project.
Depends on: "Start New Web Extraction from Runner" (if no extraction data exists yet)
Success indicators: Extraction list shows entries, images load without broken icons, state names appear, no API errors in network tab.
Failure indicators: Empty extraction list when data should exist, broken image icons, "No extractions found" message, 500 errors in network tab, loading spinner that never stops.

workflows.name: Start New Web Extraction from Runner
workflows.description:
Opens the qontinui-runner extraction panel and initiates a new web extraction on the currently visible target application.

Use when: Need to create new extraction data for testing, need to verify the runner's extraction feature works, or after making changes to extraction-related Python code (element detection, state discovery, image capture).
Verifies: Runner extraction panel opens, screenshot capture works, element detection runs successfully, states are identified, images are saved to configuration.
Prerequisites: qontinui-runner is running and visible, target application (e.g., qontinui-web) is open and visible on screen, a project/configuration is loaded in the runner.
Produces: New extraction data (states, images, elements) added to the current runner configuration. This data can then be verified in the web UI.
Success indicators: Extraction completes without errors, at least one state is detected, images appear in the runner's state list, log shows "EXTRACTION COMPLETE" with non-zero counts.
Failure indicators: Extraction hangs or times out, "0 states detected" in logs, screenshot capture fails, "ELEMENT CLASSIFIER" shows 0 items, Python errors in runner-backend.log.
